description: Authored fixed-sensor lidar geometry with complete discrete-return groups and an explicit pulse ledger. This is a reference source table, not measured lidar or a radiometric simulation.
geometry: 33 rows x41 columns. Aim x=-18+36*column/40, y=2+28*row/32, z=0.5+0.025*x+0.02*y. Sensor=(0,0,18). Ray intersection at height h has t=(18-h)/(18-aim_z) and point=(aim_x*t,aim_y*t,h). Round stored coordinates to6 decimal places. Aim is a direction reference; no-return/unavailable rows do not measure it.
scene: Roof z4.8 within x[2,9],y[6,12] yields one opaque roof-patch return; walls are not modeled. Otherwise a ray with z6.2 intersection inside ellipse centered(-7,12), radii(4.4,4.2), yields vegetation at6.2 and at3.8 except when(row+column)%3=0, followed by terrain. All other retained rays yield terrain. Ground rows at row15,column<4 are deliberately unassigned. Return ordinals increase in slant range.
amplitude: Normalized authored return amplitudes: roof0.72+0.06*sin(column*0.5), top vegetation0.38+0.05*cos(row), lower vegetation0.29+0.04*sin(column), terrain0.48+0.08*sin(aim_x*0.31)*cos(aim_y*0.23); round to6 decimals. No calibrated radiometry or physical material inference.
availability: Rows23..27 columns29..35 are unavailable with unknown count represented by an empty CSV cell. Rows3..8 columns3..8 are authored no_return detections with count0. No physical cause is assigned. Other rows retain every declared return. Missing/no-return cells are not surfaces or empty-volume certification.
classification: Codes are an explicitly authored scene lookup:0 unassigned,2 terrain,5 vegetation,6 structure. They are source annotations, not inferred classifications or a claim of LAS conformance.
timing: No per-pulse timestamps, travel times, frequency or scanning rate are supplied. Row-major pulse order is only an index. The document publication timestamp does not date the individual pulses.
tolerance: Ray tolerance1e-5 m covers decimal serialization consistency only. It is not sensor accuracy, measurement uncertainty or a claimed survey resolution.
limits: No geographic registration or physical instrument calibration
No beam footprint, divergence, propagation, receiver response, waveform or detection model
No time-of-flight inference from geometric coordinates
No material identity from intensity or automatic class accuracy
No interpolation, ground estimate under the roof, or empty-space inference
